x: In the World Indoor Championships, we were represented by Tim Benjamin, (a bronze medallist in the 4 x 400 m), Sarah Claxton, Rachel King, Chris Moss and Amy Spencer.

Chris Moss back on the track after his knee injury was always in control of the 800 metres. In the 200m the powerful Laurence Oboh defied anyone to pass him in a tight race and Jennifer Culley also found some tough competition in the women's event where she placed third.

Then second for Chris Moss in an 800 which he seemed to have won but somehow his nemesis Matt Shone dipped him on the line. Graham Beasley then got another silver in the 100m to be followed by a win from Sean Baldock who dipped under 46secs for the second time this season and defeated a lacklustre Du'aine Ladejo.

It took an hour of hard grafting before we were able to move into fifth thanks to some solid running from the 400m boys with Geoff Dearman delighted to dip under 48 again and Chris Moss working his way back to the big time with his second 1:48 800 clocking of the weekend.
